why: Savor & Wilson (2013) and later work: a large share of the equity premium is earned on days with scheduled macro announcements (employment, inflation, FOMC). FOMC days were tested (Gen153: 0.26 / -0.50); the employment report (NFP, 08:30 ET) never was. A one-session long fits the daily-flat book natively (no overnight gap needed: the session runs 18:00 ET Thursday -> 16:00 ET Friday)
dates: BLS rule: the Employment Situation is released on the third Friday after the week (Sunday-Saturday) that contains the 12th of the reference month, i.e. Saturday of that week + 20 days (checked: 2024-09 -> 2024-10-04, 2024-08 -> 2024-09-06, 2025-01 -> 2025-02-07). Known shutdown delays are not corrected (approximation)
sleeve: NFP: long ES + NQ 0.5 each for the session of the release day, Gen203 daily_book on the exact daily-flat bars (one extra round trip per held day)
judge: added to the daily-flat equity-index book (DF-3, fbook rule): 2023-26 >= 1.164 + 0.05 and 2018-22 not lower than 0.785
